name: Yamamoto Shinji
source:
A bad guy type with blonde hair, ear and nose piercings. 

In the first game he hangs out with Anjou Kaneyuki [spoiler], and ends up stabbing Tetsuya.[/spoiler] In the second game he is involved in the stories of several characters, such as [url=/c89190]Akiyoshi Chika[/url] and [url=/c89184]Gojou Sunao[/url].
